set -euo pipefail
EXPECTED=84b31d08bac81b6f46e44d11ccfe06071438b66a
git fetch origin main agent-control
test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "$EXPECTED"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
git switch main
git merge --ff-only origin/main
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('docs/STABILITY_RECOVERY_GUIDE.md')
s = p.read_text()
old_next = '- [ ] Phase 2 — make scanner/service lifecycle deterministic: one owner, idempotent Start/Stop, explicit teardown and restart behavior.'
new_next = '- [ ] Phase 2 device acceptance — install `latest-tester` build `84b31d08bac81b6f46e44d11ccfe06071438b66a` and run ADB scenarios: Start/Stop x20, Bluetooth OFF/ON, lock/unlock, background/foreground and process kill/relaunch.'
assert old_next in s
s = s.replace(old_next, new_next, 1)
phase2_marker = '## Phase 2 — Fix lifecycle and screen-off recovery\n\nPurpose: Start/Stop/restart behavior must be deterministic.\n'
assert phase2_marker in s
s = s.replace(phase2_marker, phase2_marker + '\nStatus: **SOFTWARE GATE PASS; DEVICE ACCEPTANCE PENDING.** Implementation commit: `84b31d08bac81b6f46e44d11ccfe06071438b66a`.\n', 1)
for old, new in [
    ('- [ ] Define one owner of scanner lifecycle.', '- [x] Define one owner of scanner lifecycle.'),
    ('- [ ] Make Start idempotent.', '- [x] Make Start idempotent.'),
    ('- [ ] Make Stop idempotent.', '- [x] Make Stop idempotent.'),
    ('- [ ] `ScannerService.onDestroy()` guarantees scanner shutdown.', '- [x] `ScannerService.onDestroy()` guarantees scanner shutdown.'),
    ('- [ ] No singleton scanner continues scanning after service teardown.', '- [x] No singleton scanner continues scanning after service teardown (software ownership assertion; physical verification pending).'),
    ('- [ ] Decide and document intentional service restart policy (`START_STICKY`, explicit user restart, or another justified design).', '- [x] Decide and document intentional service restart policy: `START_NOT_STICKY`; restart is explicit rather than automatic.'),
    ('- [ ] Follow-Me session reset is separated from low-level scanner technical restart.', '- [x] Follow-Me session reset is separated from low-level scanner technical restart.'),
    ('- [ ] Diagnostics record service start/stop/destroy/recovery transitions.', '- [x] Diagnostics record service start/stop/destroy/recovery transitions.'),
    ('- [ ] Start -> Start.', '- [x] Start -> Start.'),
    ('- [ ] Stop -> Stop.', '- [x] Stop -> Stop.'),
    ('- [ ] Start -> Stop -> Start x20.', '- [x] Start -> Stop -> Start x20 (policy regression test).'),
]:
    assert old in s, old
    s = s.replace(old, new, 1)
entry = '''\n\n### 2026-09-07 — Phase 2 lifecycle software gate PASS; device acceptance pending\n\n- Implementation commit: `84b31d08bac81b6f46e44d11ccfe06071438b66a` (`Stabilize scanner service lifecycle`).\n- `ScannerService` is the sole owner of `BleScanner` start/focused/stop transitions; Device Details no longer directly owns the global scanner.\n- Start/Stop are idempotent and startup ownership uses a generation gate to invalidate stale startup work across rapid Start -> Stop -> Start transitions.\n- `ScannerService.onDestroy()` performs scanner teardown; technical scanner restart no longer resets Follow-Me session state.\n- Focused scan can return deterministically to passive BLE scanning.\n- Lifecycle transitions are exposed through runtime diagnostics/export.\n- Sandbox: focused lifecycle tests PASS; full `:core:data:testDebugUnitTest` PASS; `:feature:settings:testDebugUnitTest` PASS; `qualityCheck` PASS; `:app:assembleDebug` PASS; `git diff --check` PASS.\n- Local Agent: focused lifecycle tests PASS and publisher task completed cleanly.\n- Canonical GitHub Quality #48 PASS for the exact implementation SHA, including static analysis/lint/unit tests, APK build and artifact upload. Secret Scan and Sandbox Pack also PASS.\n- Rolling `latest-tester` release now contains the APK built from this exact SHA.\n- Phase 2 is not fully accepted yet: Bluetooth OFF/ON, lock/unlock, background/foreground, process kill/relaunch and physical Start/Stop cycling remain for ADB/device validation.\n'''
if '### 2026-09-07 — Phase 2 lifecycle software gate PASS; device acceptance pending' not in s:
    s = s.rstrip() + entry + '\n'
p.write_text(s)
PY
git diff --check
git add docs/STABILITY_RECOVERY_GUIDE.md
git diff --cached --check
git commit -m 'Record Phase 2 software gate'
git push origin HEAD:main
echo FINAL_SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
